ns2:course.label: Applied Statistical Methods
ns2:course.description: Statistical methods and computer applications for agricultural and consumer economics, including descriptive statistics, probability distribution, interval estimation, hypothesis testing, analysis of variance, simple and multiple regression, and non-parametric methods. Students who have received credit for ECON 202, CPSC 440, STAT 100, or equivalent may not receive credit for this course. Prerequisite: MATH 124 or MATH 125.
